newsitem.title: USA: Sprint to expand Internet service.
newsitem.headline: Sprint to expand Internet service.

text.p: Sprint Corp said on Wednesday it would make its Internet Passport system available to people who are not Sprint customers.
The communications company also said it planned to enhance the service, in the first quarter of 1997, offering the Microsoft Internet Explorer and up-to-the-minute local content from Excite Inc.
The Internet service previously had been available only to Sprint customers.
Sprint also said it will have a new web page accessible only to users of its Internet software.
Sprint shares were down 3/8 at 40-1/4 Wednesday.
